responsibility: Implements the x86 SM4 intrinsic interface for the Chinese SM4 block-cipher acceleration instructions. It exposes 128-bit and 256-bit key-schedule and round helpers for the base `sm4` feature, then adds 512-bit forms when `sm4` is combined with `avx10.2-512`, making this header the public API for SM4 key expansion and encryption round operations across the supported vector widths.
